commentSort.description: Show YouTube's featured comments first, or the newest comments first, when comments are returned.
commentSort.title: Comment order

includeComments.description: Return comment threads on each post (up to Maximum comments) in channelPosts and postDetails modes. postComments always returns comments.
includeComments.title: Include comments

includeDetails.description: In channelPosts mode, fill the exact publish date, exact like count, comment count and a 3-comment preview. Adds one detail and one comment request per post. postDetails always returns details.
includeDetails.title: Fetch per-post details

includeReplies.description: Also fetch replies under each comment when comments are included.
includeReplies.title: Include comment replies

keyword.description: In channelPosts mode, only keep posts whose text contains this phrase. Case-insensitive. Leave empty for all posts.
keyword.title: Keyword filter

language.description: Language used for YouTube's relative times and display labels. Post text is never translated.
language.title: Interface language

market.description: Country used to render YouTube's localized labels and relative times.
market.title: Market

maxComments.description: Maximum top-level comments to keep per post when comments are included. Replies are counted separately.
maxComments.title: Maximum comments per post

maxPosts.description: Maximum posts per channel, or per run in the post modes. The run also accepts at most this many channel/post inputs. YouTube exposes at most 200 posts per channel.
maxPosts.title: Maximum posts

maxRepliesPerComment.description: Maximum replies to keep per comment when replies are included.
maxRepliesPerComment.title: Maximum replies per comment

mode.description: Choose channel posts, one post per URL/ID, or comments from post URLs/IDs.
enumTitles: One post per URL or ID
Comments from post URLs or IDs
mode.title: What to scrape

postTypes.description: In channelPosts mode, only return these post types. Leave empty to include every type. The post modes return the post URLs/IDs you give them.
postTypes.title: Post types

publishedAfter.description: In channelPosts mode, keep posts published on or after this date. Uses YouTube's exact publish date, so details are fetched when set.
publishedAfter.title: Published on or after

publishedBefore.description: In channelPosts mode, keep posts published on or before this date. Uses YouTube's exact publish date, so details are fetched when set.
publishedBefore.title: Published on or before

urls.description: Channel URLs, @handles or channel IDs when mode=channelPosts. Post URLs or post IDs when mode=postDetails/postComments.
urls.title: Channel or post URLs / IDs
